methods.summary: Deploys a subgraph schema to the database.
methods.description:
Deploys a subgraph schema to the database.

A new subgraph gets its schema and tables created and registered. The same
schema hash only updates the handler path. An additive change adds columns
and tables in place, and a breaking change reindexes by dropping and
recreating the tables.

returns.type: Promise<{ action: "created" | "unchanged" | "handler_updated" | "updated" | "reindexed"; subgraphId: string; version: string; pin?: string; diff?: DeployDiff; warnings?: string[] }>

methods.summary: Compare two multi-table subgraph schemas and return differences.
methods.description:
Compare two multi-table subgraph schemas and return differences.

Index-only changes (`indexed`/`search` flags, composite `indexes`) are
reported separately from data-shape changes: an index never requires a
rebuild, so it must never land in `changed`/breaking — flipping
`indexed: true` on a populated column used to cost a full reindex.

methods.summary: Tells whether a schema diff is breaking, with the reasons.
methods.description:
Tells whether a schema diff is breaking, with the reasons.

Breaking means removed tables, removed columns, changed column types or
removed `uniqueKeys`, which handler upserts conflict on. Index-flag and
composite-index changes are never breaking.

types.name: ContractCallFilter
types.summary: Contract event filters

fields.name: contractId
fields.description:
One contract id, or a SET of them (max 20) — the standard DeFi shape is
a router plus N pools, which used to cost N near-identical sources and
handlers. Payload types are identical per `type`, so one handler serves
the set and `event.contractId` disambiguates.

Supports `*` wildcards (e.g. `"SP1ABC….pool-*"`). Mutually exclusive
with `trait`, which resolves its own set per block.

fields.name: abi
fields.description:
Contract ABI (pass it `as const`) used to type `event.input` — the named,
decoded function arguments. Dev-provided; serialized into the deployed
definition and used at runtime to decode args by name. Omit to keep
`event.args` as a positional `unknown[]`.

Required whenever `functionName` is set. `secondlayer subgraphs deploy`
fills it in from the deployed contract for a single concrete
`contractId`; pass it yourself for wildcard, multi-contract or trait
sources, or a local deploy (`normalizeAbi()` from
`@secondlayer/stacks/clarity`).

fields.name: indexChanges
fields.description: Columns whose only change was the `indexed`/`search` flag (index DDL applied in place).

fields.name: addedUniqueKeys
fields.description: uniqueKeys added in place via ALTER TABLE … ADD CONSTRAINT.

fields.name: dropStatement
fields.description: `DROP SCHEMA … CASCADE` a destructive rebuild would run first.

fields.name: statements
fields.description: DDL the deploy will run.

fields.name: client
fields.description:
Read-only contract calls pinned to this block. Cached, so the same
(contract, function, args) is fetched once per block rather than once
per event.

Erased here on purpose: this interface is compared structurally wherever
a subgraph definition is passed around, and carrying an ABI-generic
method pushes those comparisons past TS's instantiation depth. Handlers
receive `TypedSubgraphContext`, which exposes the fully typed version.

fields.name: update
fields.type: (table: string, where: Record<string, unknown>, set: Record<string, unknown>) => void

fields.name: upsert
fields.type: (table: string, key: Record<string, unknown>, row: Record<string, unknown>) => void

fields.name: increment
fields.type: (table: string, key: Record<string, unknown>, deltas: Record<string, number | bigint>) => void
fields.description:
Atomic counter update — the blessed accumulator primitive. Applies
`col = COALESCE(col, 0) + delta` per column (insert-or-add); deltas may
be negative. Requires a uniqueKeys constraint matching `key`. Prefer
this over read-modify-write handlers for running totals.
